## Constraints

### Must

- Immutable source and engine tokens; explicit draft/review states.
- Thai-friendly system fonts and keyboard focus.
- Private game corpora stay outside the repository.

### Avoid

- Game-specific assumptions in generic AI prompts; dense whole-corpus tables.

## Decisions

- NavigationView-inspired two primary tabs (Overview/Text) and paginated split editor; latest user preference supersedes the five-menu draft.
- Research scene evidence before drafting; 50 entries per page.
- Local browser preview; staged CSV export, no installed-game writes.
- Microsoft documentation is the user-provided design reference; 21st search required unavailable sign-in.
